compute_moving_average: compute a moving average over a numpy array with a configurable window size
calculate_te_drift: calculate the total energy drift from an NVE molecular dynamics trajectory file
join_nve_md_results: join total energy drift results from multiple NVE MD trajectory files into a list
compute_nve_md_metrics: compute the mean drift in meV per atom per second from NVE MD results
save_nve_md_metrics: save NVE MD benchmark metrics to a JSON file in the results directory
